column1: # The tension loss factor eta_F of cited string constructions (README.md, "Tension loss"). A string row's optional
# `tension-loss ID` record selects one row, and the receipt prints it with the others. No violin string here is measured.
# Mansour's and Galluzzo's eta_F come from Valette fits that also fitted their own bending and air terms; only eta_F is carried.

column3: Lampis 2024 Dominant cello G (chrome-wound): mean Q 1064 over its first 30 modes, inverted on that string's own T, mu, EI and diameter with the same air law; bending loss taken as 0, so an upper bound; the violin G itself is unmeasured.

Mansour, Woodhouse & Scavone 2016 (Acta Acust. 102:1082-1093, Table 1): D'Addario Kaplan Solutions cello A3, Valette fit over the first 30 modes on a rigid base; that fit's eta_B 11.4e-2 and eta_A 0.12 1/s are not carried.

Mansour, Woodhouse & Scavone 2016 (Acta Acust. 102:1082-1093, Table 1): D'Addario Kaplan Solutions cello D3, Valette fit over the first 30 modes on a rigid base; that fit's eta_B 12.5e-2 and eta_A 0.11 1/s are not carried.
